narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Shipped Ledger"**

The site is a plain, exact record of work delivered. Every section reads like a ledger entry: what was built, for whom, when, and what it did. The work itself carries the colour (client screenshots, tool brand icons); the frame around it stays monochrome so nothing competes with the proof.

Warm and confident, not cold. Warmth comes from Geist, a humanist sans with soft terminals, the typed-out name in the header, and copy written in first-hand plain language. Confidence comes from scale and restraint: one large title, generous section spacing, and no decoration asking for attention. Density is moderate. Each block answers one question and stops.

Depth is flat. Structure comes from spacing first, then hairline rules and 1px rings. Cards are not the default container; content groups by proximity.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome neutral frame (chroma 0), colour only from the work and brand icons.
Geist throughout; monospace reserved for the typed signature.
Flat surfaces, hairline dividers, 1px rings around imagery.
Left-aligned, single 64rem column with large vertical rhythm.
Light and dark follow the system setting, same hierarchy in both.

rules.name: The Work Carries the Colour Rule
rules.body: The frame has zero chroma. Colour appears only inside project screenshots and the tech brand icons. Never add a brand accent to headings, links, buttons, or backgrounds.

rules.name: The Icon Contrast Rule
rules.body: Tech brand icons keep their brand hue, but any hue at 600 or darker gets a 400-level `dark:` variant so it holds 3:1 on Ink.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No small uppercase tracked labels above headings. Headings stand alone; a short sentence-case description may sit under them.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Geist for everything except the header signature. Monospace never appears as "technical" decoration elsewhere.

rules.name: The Exact Cell Rule
rules.body: Grids hold exactly as many cells as there is content. Five projects means one featured plus four, never a lone orphan tile.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: No `box-shadow` at rest or on hover. If something needs separation, add space first, then a hairline. A shadow is never the answer.

dos: **Do** let screenshots and brand icons be the only colour on the page.
**Do** group by spacing first; reach for a hairline only when spacing is not enough.
**Do** keep every grid at exact cell count (featured plus pairs).
**Do** give every interactive tile one link target, a visible focus ring, and a reduced-motion fallback.
**Do** check light and dark at 375px and 1440px before calling a change done.
donts: **Don't** wrap sections in cards or nest cards inside cards.
**Don't** add shadows, glows, or gradient text.
**Don't** use uppercase tracked eyebrows or section numbers.
**Don't** use monospace outside the header signature.
**Don't** use em-dashes in any visible copy; use commas or hyphens.
**Don't** ship full-page screenshots; crop to the visible top area and serve webp.
